title: Add credit notes
prompts:
Add credit notes to ledgerkit.

New module `src/credit-note.js` exporting `createCreditNote(invoice, { amount, reason, issuedAt })`, where `amount` is a Money. It must:
- throw a `ValidationError` (src/errors.js) if the amount is zero or negative, in a different currency than the invoice, or greater than the invoice's current balance (payments and earlier credit notes already count);
- return a credit note object `{ id, invoiceId, amount, reason, issuedAt }` and record it on the invoice in a new array `invoice.creditNotes` (starts empty);
- make `invoice.balance()` smaller by the sum of its credit notes (so the aging report and payment checks use the reduced balance).

Also add `ledger.postCreditNote(note, invoice)`. It posts one balanced entry dated `note.issuedAt`: credit `receivable` for the full amount, debit `revenue` for the net share, debit `tax-payable` for the tax share (leave the tax line out when the share is zero). Split the amount with `note.amount.allocate([invoice.taxTotal().cents, invoice.netTotal().cents])`, so the two shares add up exactly.

Export `createCreditNote` from `src/index.js`, and add tests under test/. Run the whole suite when you're done.
notes: Feature with a precise spec. Touches invoice.js (balance), ledger.js (a new method that follows postInvoice), a new module, index.js. The hidden suite checks every sentence of the spec, including the cent-rounding rule.
